```sh
export HELM_EXPERIMENTAL_OCI=1

```sh
helm chart pull 924646508734.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/yo-spring-chart:latest
helm chart export 924646508734.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/yo-spring-chart:latest --destination .

```sh
helm install yo-spring ./yo-spring -f ./yo-spring/values-k8s.yml -n <NAMESPACE>

helm install yo-spring ./yo-spring -f ./yo-spring/values-openshift.yml -n <NAMESPACE>
```

## Uninstalling Chart

To uninstall the chart and remove all resources from the EKS cluster:

```sh
helm uninstall yo-spring -n <NAMESPACE>
```
